description: Raw field-monitoring dataset of a long-span air-supported membrane structure (Yueqing Power Plant No.3 coal shed, October–December 2022, downsampled to 10 Hz) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Xiangyu Gong, Yanli He (Beijing University of Technology). This dataset contains the raw field-monitoring data collected by the structural health monitoring system of the air-supported membrane coal shed of Unit No.3, Yueqing Power Plant (Zhejiang, China), from October to December 2022. All records have been baseline-corrected and downsampled to 10 Hz. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
